items.title: What is Mathematics?
items.explanation: Mathematics is the search for patterns and their explanations in nature, human activities, and technology. It combines creativity (art) and logic (science). Understanding these patterns helps explain why things happen, such as how gravity allows satellites to orbit Earth or how genome patterns help cure diseases.

items.title: Patterns in Numbers
items.explanation: Mathematics studies patterns of whole numbers. Key sequences include counting numbers (1, 2, 3...), odd numbers (1, 3, 5...), even numbers (2, 4, 6...), triangular numbers (1, 3, 6...), square numbers (1, 4, 9...), and cubes (1, 8, 27...). Visualizing these sequences through pictures helps understand the underlying rules.
